platforms.name: CKUT 90.3 FM Montreal Music Submission Email and Physical Route
platforms.country: Canada / Montreal campus-community radio digital and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; music-library and programmer review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route accepts 320 kbps MP3 email submissions or physical releases, requires at least three distinct tracks except 7-inch vinyl, and does not accept singles. Owner review is required before sending email, files, metadata or physical media.
platforms.notes: Official submission instructions and current July 2026 station activity were verified on 2026-07-10. The public submission address music@ckut.ca was published on the official site. It was not contacted, SMTP/MX probed or otherwise tested.

platforms.name: Radio K KUOM Minneapolis Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Minneapolis college radio digital and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; music-department review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route requests a downloadable ZIP via Google Drive, Dropbox or similar, preferably WAV/FLAC, a Bandcamp download code/link, or a physical release. The official music-department email is protected/non-plaintext and was not decoded; all outreach and asset sharing require manual handling.
platforms.notes: Official submission instructions and current June/July 2026 station activity were verified on 2026-07-10. A music-department email link is published through protected site markup, but the address was not decoded, guessed, contacted or probed.

platforms.name: WPRB Princeton Music Submission Email and Physical Route
platforms.country: United States / Princeton independent community radio email and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; music-director review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route accepts email or mailed CDs, CD-Rs and vinyl, with physical submissions prioritized. Owner review is required before sending an email, files, links, metadata or physical media.
platforms.notes: Official music-submission instructions and live July 10, 2026 playlists/schedule were verified on 2026-07-10. The public submission address music@wprb.com was published on the official site and was not contacted or probed.

platforms.name: WKNC 88.1 FM Digital Music Submission Google Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Raleigh university radio digital music submission form route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; format-specific music-director review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official Google Form requests contact and release data, a shareable Dropbox or Google Drive download link, genre routing and FCC-clean information, and includes reCAPTCHA. Form entry, link sharing and CAPTCHA completion must remain manual.
platforms.notes: Official station pages showed charts dated 2026-07-07 and an active submission form when checked on 2026-07-10. WKNC explicitly no longer accepts emailed submissions; the authorized route is the form. Google sign-in is optional for saving progress, not required to view the form.

platforms.name: KVSC 88.1 FM St. Cloud Music Submission Email and Physical Route
platforms.country: United States / St. Cloud college and community radio email and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; music-department review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route accepts MP3s by email and CDs or vinyl by mail, prefers full albums or EPs over singles, and requests concise artist information. Owner review is required before emailing files or preparing physical media.
platforms.notes: Official submission instructions and station posts dated July 9, 2026 were verified on 2026-07-10. The public submission address music@kvsc.org was published on the official site and was not contacted or probed.
